title: Sentient (SENT) Listing Will Be Postponed
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Due to on-chain airdrop delay, the trading start time for Sentient (SENT), originally set at  2026-01-22 12:00 (UTC),  will be postponed to  2026-01-22 13:00 (UTC) .  For More Information:  Binance Will List Sentient (SENT) with Seed Tag Applied Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-01-22
